##### Project general facts

Rixos Residences offers an exclusive beachfront lifestyle that combines sophisticated homes, resort-style amenities, and the renowned hospitality of Rixos. The contemporary development features a selection of apartments, duplexes, beach houses, and villas set within beautifully landscaped surroundings, with direct access to the pristine beach. Designed as a family-friendly retreat, the community creates a relaxed atmosphere where residents can enjoy luxury, privacy, and an exceptional coastal lifestyle.

The development offers an extensive range of amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and entertainment. Residents can enjoy stunning swimming pools, lush garden terraces, beachfront leisure areas, wellness facilities, and a variety of water sports and recreational activities. The on-site Rixos hotel further enhances the experience with access to world-class hospitality and services, creating a truly all-inclusive resort environment for residents of all ages.

The residences include 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, as well as duplex apartments and beach houses, all designed to maximise natural light and views of the sea. Spacious balconies, terraces, and private gardens extend the living areas outdoors, while glass balustrades create a seamless connection with the beachfront surroundings. Interiors feature porcelain tile flooring, engineered wood details, wood veneer cabinetry, engineered stone countertops, and elegant brushed champagne metal accents. The kitchens are fully equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a major waterfront destination located along Dubai’s northern coastline, designed as a collection of four interconnected islands that combine residential, hospitality, leisure, and entertainment experiences. The area is being developed around a relaxed coastal lifestyle, with expansive waterfront spaces, sandy beaches, landscaped promenades, and views across the Arabian Gulf.

The destination offers a diverse mix of residential communities, luxury hotels, retail, dining, and recreational facilities, creating a vibrant environment for both residents and visitors. Its waterfront setting provides opportunities for beach activities, water sports, cycling, and leisurely walks, while landscaped public spaces and promenades create a peaceful connection with nature.

Dubai Islands also benefits from convenient connectivity to the rest of the city through major road networks, with Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and other key destinations within easy reach. With its combination of beachfront living, modern infrastructure, and growing selection of lifestyle amenities, Dubai Islands is emerging as one of Dubai’s distinctive new coastal destinations.
